column1: # Pinned upstream prebuilt binaries for Intel macs. See install-intel-prebuilt.sh.
# set|name|repo|tag template|version|asset template|sha256|binaries in the tree|upgrade policy
# {v} is the version, {vnd} the version with the dots removed (7-Zip names its
# archives 7z2603 for 26.03). The download URL is
# One record left: the Intel mise bootstrap. Every CLI this file used to pin
# (neovim, yazi, fzf, fastfetch, sevenzip, lnav, gh, lazygit, lazysql) is a mise
# tool now, installed from mise/.config/mise/mise.lock on both architectures.
# mise itself cannot install mise, and brew's mise formula would build Rust from
# source on Intel, so the `bootstrap` set stays.
# `install-intel-prebuilt.sh --upgrade` rewrites the version and sha256 columns
# in place when upstream has a newer release, so this file is the thing to
# review and commit after an update run.
